query_text: SELECT area, city_name, gdp FROM city

query_text: SELECT state_name, area, city_name FROM city WHERE area = 375.78

query_text: SELECT state_name, area, city_name FROM city WHERE area != 1314.80 AND population = 887642
nl_query: What is the name, state, and geographic area of each city where an NBA team is based?

query_text: SELECT age, nba_team, name FROM owner WHERE nba_team != 'Cleveland Cavaliers'

query_text: SELECT age, nba_team, name FROM owner WHERE nba_team != 'Golden State Warriors' AND age >= 66

query_text: SELECT mvp_awards, draft_pick, fiba_world_cup FROM player WHERE fiba_world_cup <= 0

query_text: SELECT position, nationality, age FROM player WHERE age < 91

query_text: SELECT founded_year, ownership, team_name FROM team WHERE ownership != '  '

query_text: SELECT ownership, championship, founded_year FROM team WHERE founded_year < 1989

query_text: SELECT position, MIN(olympic_gold_medals) AS min_olympic_gold_medals FROM player GROUP BY position

query_text: SELECT position, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM player GROUP BY position
nl_query: For each NBA player, what is their playing position and age?

query_text: SELECT team.championship, team.location, player.age, player.olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name

query_text: SELECT team.founded_year, team.team_name, player.name, player.team FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name

query_text: SELECT player.position, MIN(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS min_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name GROUP BY player.position

query_text: SELECT player.position, MIN(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS min_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN owner ON team.ownership = owner.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name GROUP BY player.position
nl_query: For each NBA player, what is their playing position, how many Olympic gold medals have they won, which team do they play for, who owns the team, and what city is the team in?

query_text: SELECT nationality, SUM(age) AS sum_age FROM owner WHERE age != 76 AND nba_team != 'Houston Rockets' GROUP BY nationality

query_text: SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS count_all FROM player WHERE name = 'Antonius Cleveland' OR nba_championships >= 0 GROUP BY nationality

query_text: SELECT player.nationality, MIN(player.olympic_gold_medals) AS min_player_olympic_gold_medals FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE player.fiba_world_cup > 0 GROUP BY player.nationality
nl_query: For each NBA player, what is their nationality, how many Olympic gold medals have they won, and which team do they play for?

query_text: SELECT owner.nationality, MAX(player.mvp_awards) AS max_player_mvp_awards FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN owner ON team.ownership = owner.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE city.population < 1603797 OR team.location != 'Minneapolis' GROUP BY owner.nationality

query_text: SELECT nationality, MIN(age) AS min_age FROM owner WHERE nba_team != 'Cleveland Cavaliers' GROUP BY nationality

query_text: SELECT player.draft_pick, team.team_name, player.fiba_world_cup, team.location FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name WHERE player.fiba_world_cup > 0
